Global Access Control

When enabled, visitors must log in to view protected materials.

Quick Guide

→ USE "SUBJECTS" TAB TO VIEW/MERGE/RENAME SUBJECTS ACROSS ALL SECTIONS.
→ ALL SUBJECT NAMES ARE AUTO-NORMALIZED (Case-Insensitive).
→ ADD / EDIT / DELETE IN NOTES, ANSWERS, PYQ, VIDEOS, LINKS, GATE, CUSTOM.
→ LIBRARY: Manage E-Books & Reference PDFs with Cover + Stream/Yr/Sem filters.
→ POPUP: SET SITE-WIDE ANNOUNCEMENT BANNERS (WITH MUSIC + LINK).
→ USERS: Manage students, ban/unblock, track live usage.
→ USAGE: Top 5 & All users' activity time.
→ MOCK TEST: Create image-based tests, assign timer & target by Stream/Year/Semester or Specific Users, track submissions & assign marks.
→ CA PAPERS: Manage CA1, CA2, CA3, CA4 question papers submitted via Google Drive links.
